text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clearer thesis in first sentence","quality":"claim clarity","description":"The essay states its position more directly and unmistakably at the outset."},{"evidence":"body paragraph with counterargument and rebuttal","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges reasons people might support driverless cars and then answers them, which makes the argument more convincing."},{"evidence":"references to construction sites, accidents, and malfunction","quality":"use of source support","description":"It ties its points more concretely to details from the article instead of relying mostly on generic opinion."},{"evidence":"discussion of alertness, hand-eye coordination, and responsibility","quality":"reasoning development","description":"It explains why the technology would be a problem by connecting driverless cars to broader effects on human skills and accountability."},{"evidence":"more organized paragraph progression","quality":"overall organization","description":"Its ideas move in a more controlled sequence from introduction to supporting reasons to conclusion."}]}
